# codex-swarm v0.8.3

This patch release lets app-server workers select a Codex model at spawn time.

## Added

- `cs spawn --engine appserver --model <model-id>` forwards the model to native
  Codex `thread/start`.
- Model selection participates in durable spawn replay identity, preventing a
  retry from silently switching models.
- Omitting `--model` preserves the user's configured Codex default.
